language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, my name is Chip!
Hi, I'm Marie. I'm going with my older brother as a volunteer on this amazing boat trip on the Amazon river.
We're going to help clean up the river bank af a few places as we travel from Manaus.
We're going to be stopping at 5 places on the trip.
We first have to buy supplies for the trip and I'm going to need your help to total up our purchases.
It's easy to multiply a number like 200 by 12 without a calculator.
But calculating the cost of a number of items and adding it all up is a wee bit more difficult, don't you think?
Will you come along with us on this trip, where well learn and enjoy?
Marie is going to have a great time on this boat trip and learn a lot of math along the way! Why don't you'll join her and you have fun too

See the map of the route we're going to follow. The captain says the speed of the boat is 12 km/hour. For each day, he has planned a certain number of hours to travel from one place to the next. Let's check if his estimates are correct.
